expectations.text: The review flags the clickable div for search (not keyboard accessible, no role or name) and the icon-only delete button without an accessible name
expectations.evidence: Row 4 says the search is a `<div onClick>` that "You can't Tab to it or trigger it with Enter or Space, and screen readers don't announce it as a button"; row 5 says "Icon-only controls have no accessible name" and recommends adding `aria-label="Delete"`.

expectations.text: The review flags blocked paste on the input and the destructive delete action without confirmation
expectations.evidence: Row 9 says "Paste is blocked: `onPaste={e => e.preventDefault()}`" and row 7 says "Delete runs immediately with no confirmation."

expectations.text: The review flags the fixed toolbar using 100vh (dvh) and/or missing safe-area handling
expectations.evidence: Row 1 flags `height: '100vh'` and suggests `100dvh`; row 2 flags "Fixed to `bottom: 0` with no safe-area padding" and recommends `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`.
